title: Rewarding Intellectual Humility: Learning When Not to Answer in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper uses the term 'intellectual humility' as a technical metaphor for uncertainty calibration and the ability of an LLM to abstain from answering (saying 'I don't know') to prevent hallucinations. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical systems; instead, it tests its method on medical and mathematical datasets.
